  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    ConceptMapExtensions
    The IPF extensions on a ConceptMap, in one place, so that ConceptMapLoader and ConceptMapWriter agree on their URLs and shapes.
    ConceptMapJsonLoader
    MappingLoader for FHIR R4 ConceptMap resources in the JSON wire format, claiming *.conceptmap.r4.json by name and conceptmap-r4-json by format id.
    ConceptMapLoader
    Shared implementation for the two MappingLoaders that read FHIR R4 ConceptMap resources: ConceptMapJsonLoader for *.conceptmap.r4.json and ConceptMapXmlLoader for *.conceptmap.r4.xml.
    ConceptMapWriter
    Writes Mappings as a FHIR R4 ConceptMap, so that a mapping maintained in any of IPF's formats can be published as the standard resource for the job - authored on from there in Simplifier or Forge, shipped in an Implementation Guide, or served by a terminology server.
    ConceptMapXmlLoader
    MappingLoader for FHIR R4 ConceptMap resources in the XML wire format, claiming *.conceptmap.r4.xml by name and conceptmap-r4-xml by format id.
